rewrites.comment: SPA fallback so /about, /adopt, /donate and friends survive a refresh or a direct link. Vercel checks the filesystem before rewrites, so real files under /hero, /assets and /brand are still served normally.

headers.comment: Vite content-hashes these filenames, so a new build is a new URL and they can be cached forever.

The film keeps the SAME filename across builds, so it must NOT be immutable. An hour fresh, then served stale while it revalidates in the background: re-running scripts/grade.sh still reaches returning visitors.
